messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up - multiple enterprise customers reporting p95/p99 spikes on function-calling routes since ~03:20 UTC. Symptoms: increased time in 'schema-validate' span and 'tool-router' queue. Example route: /v1/funcs/invoice-gen. Traces attached.

Sam Patel: Oncall here — can you paste a sample trace id and a minimal curl we can run to repro?

Maya Chen: Trace: trace-0a7f3b9c. Quick repro (sanitized):
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'x-request-id:acme-001' \
  -d '{"input":"generate invoice","functions":[{"name":"create_invoice","schema":{...big schema...}}]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Shows schema payload in body and structured output enforcement enabled.

Li Wang: I pulled the trace. There's a ~600-800ms pause inside schema validator compile on cold path, plus router queueing spikes. Baseline p95 for this route historically ~180ms -> now ~600ms, p99 ~1.6s. Looks like validators are being JIT-compiled per-request when schema size > ~3KB.

Ashley Rivera: Any recent rollouts around validator libs or router changes?

ci-bot: deploy:deployed v2.14.0 to prod at 2024-11-03T03:15:12Z (sha: deadbeef)

Sam Patel: If validator compile is the culprit, short-term mitigations: enable schema cache for the route or set soft_validation=true so we skip strict compile. Can we toggle per-customer?

Maya Chen: Customer is OK with temporary degrade in structured checks. Can ops flip validation off for their route? It's an enterprise account (acct: ACME_CORP). Need steps.

Li Wang: I opened PR #4589 to early-return expensive compile and enable a runtime cache for compiled validators. Patch reduces cold compile by caching compiled bytecode keyed by schema-hash. Rolling a canary now (canary id c-233).

Sam Patel: Also proposing temporary routing rule: send ACME_CORP function-calls to fallback model variant (low-latency) and set route config: {"structured_validation":"soft"}. Ops, can you apply that while Li's canary is evaluated?

Ashley Rivera: Approving temporary config change for ACME_CORP. Maya, CSM to notify customer that this is temporary and we'll follow up post full rollout.

Maya Chen: Quick repro steps I recorded for the ticket: 1) send request with embedded 4KB schema; 2) observe span 'schema-validate' ~700ms in trace UI; 3) p95 increases for that route in the last 10m window. Ticket INC-4721. Noted no billing delta expected for toggling validation.

Li Wang: Canary metrics so far (10 minutes after canary): route p95 reduced from ~600ms -> ~220ms, p99 down to ~420ms. Compiler cache hit-rate climbing to ~78%. Will promote to 20% in 15m, 100% if stable.

Sam Patel: Thanks. Create an ephemeral alert to watch schema-validate latency > 300ms for 5m on that route. If threshold fires, auto-rollback canary.

ci-bot: monitoring: alert rule created (ar-998) by Sam Patel.

Ashley Rivera: CSM will send customer update in 30m and confirm their acceptance of temporary config. Good job team. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: I'll add the repro curl + small schema sample to the ticket and follow up once Li promotes. Closing loop with customer once 100% rollout done.

Li Wang: One follow-up item: add a lint rule to our function router deploys to warn when schema > 2KB or if schema nesting > 6 levels. That reduces surprise heavy schemas on prod. Filed TECH-849.

Sam Patel: Marking incident as mitigated for now; leaving monitoring open until 48h stable.

Maya Chen: ACK.
